instruction: Please create a backup of all my inbox emails in the folder ~/inbox_backup. Export each message as a separate .eml file.

expect: 歡迎使用新的 Outlook.com 帳戶.*\.eml

metadata.explanation: Task requires exporting all inbox emails to ~/inbox_backup folder in .eml format. Evaluator verifies that .eml files with expected email subjects are created. Uses existing check_list metric with regex patterns to match the known email subjects in the Thunderbird profile.

llm_judge_reasons: Evaluator correctly uses ls -R to list all files in the backup directory
check_list metric appropriately uses regex patterns to match .eml file names
Expected regex patterns correctly match the 2 known email subjects in the test Thunderbird profile
Data flow is correct: ls output -> cache file -> check_list -> regex matching
Postconfig command properly captures the directory listing for verification
llm_judge_fix_suggestions: Minor limitation: Evaluator only verifies 2 specific emails exist, not that ALL emails were backed up (acceptable for test profile with only 2 emails, but wouldn't scale to unknown inbox contents)
Could add 'unexpect' patterns to verify no unexpected files were created
Could verify the .eml files are valid format (not just checking filenames)
